gen-fs-oswald-gf-marcellus: Marcellus reads like etched glass, its strokes shifting weight so softly you barely notice. Oswald is built to stand up tall and tightly packed, while Marcellus is built for quiet, rounded lines with a clear opening.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-martel: Martel reads like a familiar editorial serif, moderate in contrast with wide horseshoe openings. Against Oswald's tight, forceful display lines, the pair's strongest quality is how readily it moves from shout to sentence.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-nanum-myeongjo: Nanum Myeongjo reads softly, its curve tips stopping short of touching and its strokes barely modulating. Nanum Myeongjo gives the quiet brushed texture that Oswald, packed tight and confident, leaves out, and that gap is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-serif-hk: Noto Serif HK reads dignified and editorial, with generous gaps where its curves end and crossbars slightly thinner than stems. Oswald is best at tight, confident force; this serif is best at tempered, steady text.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-serif-jp: Noto Serif JP reads literary and refined, with an unclenched c. Oswald's tightly knit confidence sits above its faintly modulated serif line, and the joins taper modestly instead of vanishing.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-serif-kr: Oswald leads with confident, tightly knit display strength. Noto Serif KR follows with wide, barely curled s curves and mild thick-thin shifts, so a longer passage would glide along smoothly, never stark and never flat.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-serif-sc: Tight, strong, then suddenly open: Oswald packs its rows close and sounds confident. And Noto Serif SC settles beside it as a refined text serif, its rounded letters thickening slightly at the sides and its c openings clear enough to see through.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-serif-tc: Oswald is all tightly knit rows and confident display strength, with very little line-weight play. Noto Serif TC adds the restrained thick-thin touch of a worn wooden stamp, and that mix of force and held-open restraint is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-petrona: Petrona reads dignified and editorial, with shallow terminal curls and wide gaps. Oswald packs its rows tight and strong above, while Petrona's tempered contrast ebbs and flows below it.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-poly: Tight and strong up top, bookish and soft below: Oswald is confident display type, while Poly thins slightly at the sides of its bowls. Oswald does force best; Poly does gentle, literary cadence best.
